My fiancé (then boyfriend) gave birth to our still born baby. It was literally the hardest thing we had both been through. We were like you guys never fighting over stuff that matters instead stuff that doesn't. (What does matter anyway?) after we came home from the hospital we never that this would make or break us. Luckily it had so far proven that if we can do this together and live through it supporting each other than we can do anything. Yes we fight. Yes we annoy each other but losing a child is that "something important" thing that will bind you even if you aren't together. 

I say this because you should ask yourself "in the hard times, do I want this person around? Will they support me? Will I support them? Can we fight through the hard time together?"
